Kempener, R. and Saygin, D. (2014). Renewable Energy in Manufacturing: A technology roadmap for REmap 2030. International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), Abu Dhabi, June 2014. 36 pp.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 2). A high-level roadmap: technology costs are given only as charts (Figure 4 cost-supply curve of substitution costs by option; Figure 6 solar thermal versus boiler heat production costs 2010/2030, bars without printed values) and the detailed techno-economics are deferred to a separate IRENA working paper ('Renewable Technology Options for the Manufacturing Industry') and the IRENA/ETSAP technology briefs. Main file (5 technologies, 8 process contexts): solar process heat maximum steam temperature 400 degC and status; Table 4 production costs of bio-based ethylene by region (USD/t) and of fossil ethylene, bio-methanol and fossil methanol (EUR/t), reprinted from IRENA 2013 briefs (I13 bio-ethylene = etsap_2013_009, I09 bio-methanol = etsap_2013_007, both already held: check for duplication). _other-values.csv: the one printed substitution cost (solar thermal USD 2/GJ), CO2-price assumptions, solar cost-decline projection and potentials. Not extracted: chart-only values, stakeholder scoring tables (Tables 1-3, 5-7, 9), sector potentials in EJ, SME qualitative tables. No biomass boiler/CHP, heat pump or geothermal cost or performance numbers are printed.

No price year for Table 4 costs (loaded with 2014 and flagged); Table 4 mixes USD (ethylene) and EUR (methanol). Footnote 3 prints '1 EJ is 1019 joules' (10^19 with the superscript lost); 1 EJ is 10^18 J.
